decisions.reason: Report identifies node.exe PID 42432 (dsh web host) from running-processes.txt as the koffi.node loader, and explains the loaded native binary stays in use until the process exits, so npm's copyfile fails with EBUSY (attempt1-ebusy.log). Grounded in fixture files.

Explicitly explains a browser refresh reloads only the SPA while the host process stays alive and keeps the lock, and gives an ordered stop-verify-install-restart procedure as separate numbered steps without prescribing killing every unrelated Node process.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: explains unpinned install resolves to latest (= 0.1.1-rc.2), alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5, so alpha.4 is silently replaced by the older rc.2; correctly frames this as npm not preserving the installed version.

Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, with restart and dsh --version verification of 0.1.2-alpha.5; @alpha is mentioned only as a nondeterministic alternative, not a replacement.

Advises README authors to pin the exact tested core version and avoid silently following latest over an existing prerelease; accepts both pinned combined one-liner and separate pinned host/plugin steps; the unpinned BAD pattern is clearly rejected advice.
